policy: Every authored sample names its actual cause. Code proves a project damage path, not an original-work visual reference. User rules override code. Grade dimensions and colors remain authored project design, not sourced facts.

user_thermal.locator: 2026-10-22 当前会话：烧伤只有可能是脚部或者全身性质，不存在局部
user_thermal.supports: Only sole and whole-body thermal scopes; no isolated scalp burn or thermal core-hole sample.

user_hair.locator: 2026-10-22 当前会话：砸击随体表凹陷，裂伤处断发直接消失，不做散落头发
user_hair.supports: Shared dent deformation and local severing only at a genuine break.

user_filling.locator: 2026-10-22 当前会话：中枢馅与周边材质区别过强、边界感太强
user_filling.supports: Continuous material family without an isolated organ-like shell.

injury_code.supports: Actual damage-source mapping and project grades; not a visual authority.

body_signs.supports: Existing mechanical opening grades; does not authorize arbitrary thermal holes.

body_l36.locator: L36 身体与面皮、足部与行动、馅与中枢馅
body_l36.supports: Elastic skin, heat-damaged sole and deep central filling. Original page timed out during this review; repository extract only.

dense_filling_e01.supports: Central filling described as denser filling; not a differently colored organ. Read on 2026-10-22; author labels the work personal setting. Numerical proportions are not adopted.

friction_contact.label: 滚动／拖行摩擦
friction_contact.visual_boundary: Shallow directional scuff; grades do not make a core cavity.

blade_cut.label: 刀刃切割
blade_cut.visual_boundary: Directional split; these samples do not claim to depict tooth spacing, projectile entry or explosion damage.

blunt_impact.label: 钝击／落物压击
blunt_impact.locator: kind: default DENT; crush: FALLING_ANVIL / FALLING_BLOCK
blunt_impact.visual_boundary: Compression precedes rupture; grade 1/2 preserve skin and hair topology.

hot_floor.label: 热地板接触足底
hot_floor.visual_boundary: Continuous underside and sole edge only; no scalp spot or thermal core hole.

body_fire.label: 全身着火
body_fire.locator: kind: IS_FIRE -> SCORCH; whole-body extent required by current user rule
body_fire.visual_boundary: Whole body and hair share continuous heat damage. Existing runtime anchor still conflicts with this scope.

runtime_gaps: InjuryModel currently treats heated_awl as local SCORCH; incompatible with the current two-scope rule. No art is exported for that path.
IN_FIRE/LAVA currently use soleSite; fire context and whole-body coverage still need runtime integration.
BodySigns currently allows deep SCORCH to expose core; no corresponding thermal-only cavity is authored.
TEAR also groups projectile, bite, thorn, explosion and hard-fall sources; the blade samples do not prove those distinct shapes. Runtime cause-specific art selection remains pending.
